Name: Catalogue Framework
Author: Leroymilo
Description:
[size=6]For Players
[/size][size=3]If this mod is required by a mod you want, install it.

[/size][size=6]For Developers and Content Pack Makers[/size]
[size=5]I HIGHLY recommend using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url] instead of this mod because I will not work on this anymore while the Furniture Framework is being maintained.[/size]
[size=3]
Go [url=https://github.com/Leroymilo/Catalogue-Framework/blob/main/ReadMe.md]here[/url] to see a detailed description of how to make a custom catalogue. If you're used to Content Patcher, this shouldn't be hard.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Unzip this file in your mod folder (now with update key).

Manifest.Name: Catalogue Framework
Manifest.Description: Allows a Content Pack to create a custom Shop on a Furniture
